description: This file defines API handlers for team-related operations in the focalboard server, including retrieving team info, managing signup tokens, and fetching team users.

classes.name: API
classes.description: API struct that contains methods for handling team-related API endpoints.

methods.name: registerTeamsRoutes
methods.description: Registers team-related API routes to the provided mux.Router.

methods.name: handleGetTeams
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all teams for the current user.

methods.name: handleGetTeam
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve information about a specific team by ID.

methods.name: handlePostTeamRegenerateSignupToken
methods.description: Handles POST request to regenerate the signup token for the root team.

methods.name: handleGetTeamUsers
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve users of a specific team.

methods.name: handleGetTeamUsersByID
methods.description: Handles POST request to retrieve specific users by their IDs within a team.
